note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated India customs export records with destination, HS code and BOL numbers, latest 2026-02-27, destinations Togo, Ghana, Guinea, Cote d'Ivoire, Mali, DR Congo — pattern is a merchant exporter of industrial/MRO spares and consumables to West/Central African cement and steel plants. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 820740 ('tools for tapping or threading') does not match any observed shipment line; actual observed codes are 84834000, 68061000, 82090010, 73269099, 85372000. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground — company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual mix (multi-product trader, no single HS), verdict accepted_hs_corrected.
